3. Smt. Karuna W/o Sh. Dheeresh Verma, D/o Sh. Rajesh  Kumar, Aged About 35 Years, B/c Darji, R/o 195, Subhash  Colony, Bhagat Ki Kothi, Jodhpur.
----Petitioners  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Nagraj Goswami

For Respondent(s) : Mr. S.K. Mehar, PP  Ms. Manasvi Choudhary, for petitioner  No.3 (complainant)
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 16/05/2023 The instant misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed against the order dated 25.04.2023 passed by the Family Court & Special Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate (PCPNDT Act Cases) Jodhpur Metropolitan in criminal case No.17/18 (NCV No.6522/2018) (arising out of FIR No.106/2017 lodged at Police Station Mahila Thana West, Jodhpur) registered against the petitioners No.1 & 2 for offence under Sections 498-A and 406 of IPC on the basis of compromise.

[2023/RJJD/015519] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-2505/2023] Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, since the petitioners No.1 & 2 and petitioner No.3 (complainant in this matter) have arrived at compromise and settled their dispute and in the view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex court in the case of B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana, reported in 2003 (4) SCC p.675 in which it Dheeresh vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/015519) on 16 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7672554/
1 has been held that the proceedings under Section 498A IPC can be quashed because it is the matrimonial matter, the order dated 25.04.2023 passed by the Family Court & Special Addl.
